d: Unseen hands grabbing jackets, flying debris in locked isolation cells, and towering black silhouettes moving against dim concrete walls without casting a light source. Diving straight into the physical side of unresolved supernatural activity, this retrospective captures the crew at their most vulnerable as aggressive poltergeist phenomena erupt without warning. Watch the team scramble across historic ruins and abandoned institutional wards to document unmistakable physical impacts and chilling temperature plummets that leave scientific instruments peaking. With zero rational explanations…
